Class MazeApiProvider

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.mazeengine.service.api.MazeApiProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
MazeEngineApi
public final class MazeApiProvider extends Object implements MazeEngineApi
Implements the Bukkit-registered public API using the plugin's internal services.

The provider exposes registry, preset, and operation adapters without placing their implementation classes in the consumable API JAR. It checks server thread and enabled-plugin access, converts saved records to immutable public snapshots, and caches graph summaries by layout identity.

Terminal service outcomes are translated into completion or failure events. Successful deletion produces a retained DELETED snapshot; failed planning can produce an event with no maze description. Wrapper exceptions are unwrapped before being exposed as public failure causes.

      Description copied from interface: MazeEngineApi
